BiblicalUsage: Chidon is a place in Palestine, the threshingfloor where the ark stopped. 1 Chronicles 13:9 says that when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Chidon is remembered for one terrible moment: the place where a good intention touched what God said not to touch, and the ark went on without Uzza.
